source._comment: LIVE. Hawaii Office of Elections posts a daily statewide 'Absentee Reconciliation' PDF (AbsenteeReconState-YYYYMMDD.pdf) on its Voting Report page: per county ELECT sent/voted/invalid, EV voted, MAIL sent/voted/invalid, VOTED, TOTAL, plus a statewide row (checked against the county sum). All-mail state with no party registration -> turnout-only; mail_provided = outstanding ballots -> ballot chase. Per-county PDFs by district/precinct (AbsenteeReconDP-0N-*) also exist but aren't needed.
